rulesInterpretations: The plural foreclaws label is one secondary attack, so Deinonychus has four attacks, not five.
Powerful Bite is always applicable and reaches exactly twice the signed Strength modifier without doubling any other damage.
Grab permits the Tyrannosaurus's own size or smaller; Swallow Whole separately permits one category smaller.
Swallow occurs only after the target was held in the mouth at the start of a later qualifying turn/round and a new check succeeds.
